title: Auth — OOB Prove — payload
description: The lock holder proves membership and the number on the starter's screen by carrying a signed auth/oob/identify document, and gets back the service-signed step 2. Issued and signed by the lock key `K_a`. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, parentThreadId, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

identify.description: A complete, signed auth/oob/identify/0.2 Trust Task document, issued by the approving DID and signed by its VTA for `authentication`. The service verifies it as a document in its own right — envelope, proof and payload against that specification's schema — over the members exactly as received: its proof covers every member, so it is deliberately an open object here rather than a typed one a binding could narrow.

Response.title: Auth — OOB Prove — response payload (step 2)
Response.description: Step 2 of the disclosure ladder, signed by the service's assertionMethod key: the step 1 members unchanged, plus the starter's key, where the request came from, which DID was identified and, optionally, the task families the starter key would sign for. The SHA-256 of its JCS canonical form, proof included, is the grant's `contextDigest`. For `deviceEnrol`, step 2 also names the client and the scope ceiling it asks for, and never offers a signing scope.

decisionClosesAt.description: Unchanged from step 1 (auth/oob/claim/0.3): when the decision window closes, as an RFC 3339 date-time.

sessionKey.description: The starter key `K_b`. For `login`, the key a grant would let act as the identified DID; for `deviceEnrol`, the key a grant would make the subject of a new ACL entry.

identifiedAs.description: The DID that issued the verified identify document. A grant must come from this DID. For `deviceEnrol`, an administrator of the VTA.

signingScope.description: The task families the service offers to let the starter key sign for, as `identifiedAs`, for the session a grant would arm (auth/oob/grant/0.4). Fixed by the service for the surface at `origin`. Absent: the grant delegates no signing. `login` only: MUST be absent for `deviceEnrol`.

client.description: For `deviceEnrol` only, and then REQUIRED: the client the request names, as auth/oob/request/0.3 carried it. Self-asserted by the client.

requestedScope.description: For `deviceEnrol` only, and then REQUIRED: the ceiling the request asks for, as auth/oob/request/0.3 carried it, unchanged. The grant chooses within it.
